component.name: Nubo
component.summary: Play Game Boy and Game Boy Color games

description.p: Nubo is a cycle-accurate Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator. It emulates every model from the first Game Boy to the Game Boy Advance and is checked against thousands of hardware test ROMs.

ul.li: A game library built from your ROM folders, with each game's title screen or box art
Save states with pictures, and continuing where you left off
Keyboard and controller controls you can change, and menus you can use with a controller
Gray, green or Pocket colors for Game Boy games, and light and dark themes

description.p: Nubo comes without games: it plays the ROM files (.gb, .gbc or .zip) you add.
The screenshot shows Tobu Tobu Girl Deluxe by Tangram Games, licensed under CC BY 4.0.

screenshot.caption: Playing Tobu Tobu Girl Deluxe by Tangram Games

ul.li: An installer for Windows that needs no administrator rights, with a Start menu entry, an uninstaller and an option to open Game Boy games with Nubo
A zip for Windows to run Nubo without installing it
Nubo has its own icon on Windows and no longer opens a console window next to it
Downloads are named after their system, and the README links to the latest ones

description.p: The first release of Nubo: a cycle-accurate Game Boy and Game Boy Color emulator that passes thousands of hardware test ROMs.

ul.li: Every model from the first Game Boy to the Game Boy Advance
A game library with title screens and box art
Save states, fast forward, fullscreen and screenshots
Keyboard and controller controls you can change
